package course

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// UpsertCourseI18nInput holds localization data.
type UpsertCourseI18nInput struct {
	CourseID    string
	I18nID      int
	Title       string
	Description string
}

// UpsertCourseI18n creates or updates course localization.
type UpsertCourseI18n struct {
	Courses    repository.CourseRepository
	CourseI18n repository.CourseI18nRepository
	I18n       repository.I18nRepository
	Tx         repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle upserts localization.
func (uc UpsertCourseI18n) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpsertCourseI18nInput) (*domain.CourseI18n, error) {
	var entry domain.CourseI18n
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if in.CourseID == "" {
			return domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		courseEntity, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, in.CourseID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if in.I18nID <= 0 {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		i18n, err := uc.I18n.GetByID(ctx, in.I18nID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		entry = domain.CourseI18n{
			CourseID:    courseEntity.ID,
			I18nID:      i18n.ID,
			Title:       in.Title,
			Description: in.Description,
		}
		if err := uc.CourseI18n.Upsert(ctx, entry); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &entry, nil
}
